item.title: SKT challenges $91M data breach fine in court
item.description: SK Telecom has filed a lawsuit seeking to overturn the $91 million fine imposed by the Personal Information Protection Commission following the USIM data breach in April 2025.

item.title: Eurobites: Nokia lands converged charging gig at Proximus
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Germany sets out copper migration strategy; CK Hutchison in talks over Three Ireland sale, says report; CityFibre expands small-business offer.

item.title: FWA packs on more marketing muscle
item.description: Wave7 Research's Jeff Moore joins the podcast to discuss how mobile network operators and MNO-owned brands such as TracFone, Straight Talk and Mint Mobile are beefing up promotions and marketing of FWA services.

item.title: Wi-Fi 8 targets better – not necessarily faster – connections
item.description: Wi-Fi 7 tacked on capacity to support multi-gig broadband. With a major focus on reliability, Wi-Fi 8 will enhance mesh networks and eliminate dead spots – components that broadband operators will wield as a differentiator.

item.title: AT&T Business picks Inseego for 5G FWA
item.description: AT&T Business has added Inseego's newest 5G FWA device to its lineup of fixed wireless products for Internet Air enterprise service. #pressrelease

item.title: Bevan Slattery's Subco plans $471M trans-Pacific cable
item.description: Subco, owned by Bevan Slattery, plans an all-deepwater link connecting Sydney and San Diego, scheduled for service in late 2028 and reportedly costing AU$700 million (US$471 million).

item.title: Charter earmarks $1M for 2026 digital education grants
item.description: Charter said it will award $1 million Spectrum Digital Education grants this year, extending the program's total investment to more than $12 million since 2017. #pressrelease

item.title: Charter rolls out Wi-Fi 7 extenders
item.description: Charter has launched a line of Wi-Fi 7 extenders, offering them for $5 per month each. The extenders provide an additional 2,000 square feet of coverage. #pressrelease

item.title: Netflix pivots to all-cash offer for WBD's studios and streaming biz
item.description: In a bid to stymie Paramount's hostile all-cash offer for all of Warner Bros. Discovery, Netflix has shifted to an all-cash offer for WBD's studios and streaming business. The revised deal aims to simplify and expedite the transaction.

item.title: India's smartphone shipments fell by 1% in 2025 - Omdia
item.description: Market leader vivo dominated Q4 and the full year 2025, with Samsung coming in second place.#pressrelease
